description: Compact public-source projections for context-specific motion amendment contracts. The selected amendment lists and decisions are not complete target or sitting coverage. English wording is preserved verbatim; source IDs, list gaps, relationships and retrieval times are retained. No adopted-wording survival claim is encoded.

amendments.onBehalfOf: on behalf of the PPE Group
amendments.originalText: D.	whereas the strategy of Islamist entryism relies, in particular, on the organised confusion between Islam as a religion, which falls under freedom of conscience, and political Islam as a societal project, which seeks to produce collective norms, derogatory regimes or community allegiances placed above common law;
amendments.proposedText: D.	whereas the strategy of Islamist entryism relies, in particular, on the organised confusion between Islam as a religion, which falls under freedom of conscience, and political Islam as a societal project, which seeks to produce collective norms, derogatory regimes or community allegiances placed above common law; whereas such a project may contribute to the development of parallel communities and to practices incompatible with democratic principles and EU values, thereby undermining social cohesion and individuals’ ability to participate fully in public life;

amendments.onBehalfOf: on behalf of the PPE Group
amendments.proposedText: Ea.	whereas, within Islamist ecosystems, the promotion of religious dress among minors may serve as a marker of ideological conformity and as a vector of Islamist influence; whereas such practices may raise concerns regarding the free development of minors, freedom of conscience and equality between women and men;

amendments.onBehalfOf: on behalf of the PPE Group
amendments.proposedText: 7a.	Pays tribute to all victims of Islamist terrorism and expresses its full support for their families, as well as for all whistleblowers, intellectuals, journalists, artists and political figures directly threatened by Islamist movements; commends the courage of all those who have broken with Islamist movements or who publicly denounce Islamist ideology despite threats to their safety;

amendments.onBehalfOf: on behalf of the PPE Group
amendments.proposedText: 13a.	Calls on the Member States, in accordance with EU and national law, to ensure that the active promotion of Islamist ideologies advocating the subjugation of women, antisemitism or hatred against Christians has appropriate legal and administrative consequences, including as regards access to public funding, public benefits and institutional support;

gaps.message: Individual amendment text is unavailable for numbers 14, 16, 17, 19.

amendments.onBehalfOf: on behalf of the Renew Group
amendments.originalText: 1.	Condemns Islamist entryism strategies aimed at weakening democratic institutions, the rule of law, equality between women and men, freedom of conscience, freedom of expression, public order, social cohesion and the values enshrined in Article 2 TEU;
amendments.proposedText: 1.	Condemns religious and, in particular, Islamist entryism strategies as an unacceptable form of covert and malicious interference aimed at weakening democratic institutions, the rule of law and the neutrality of public institutions; is concerned by the fact that religious entryism spearheads efforts to roll back women’s rights and gender equality, sexual health and reproductive rights, LGBTIQ+ rights, equality between women and men, freedom of conscience, freedom of expression, public order, social cohesion and the values enshrined in Article 2 TEU;

amendments.onBehalfOf: on behalf of the Renew Group
amendments.originalText: 3.	Recalls that protecting Muslim citizens against discrimination is a democratic obligation, but that recognising organised Islamist networks as representative interlocutors constitutes a political and institutional failure;
amendments.proposedText: 3.	Recalls that protecting Muslim citizens against discrimination is a democratic obligation and condemns any political discourse that distorts the legitimate fight against malicious entryism to fuel racism, xenophobia and anti-Muslim hatred;

amendments.onBehalfOf: on behalf of The Left Group
amendments.originalText: 8.	Decries the continued suppression by the Russian authorities of any form of dissent, including through repressive legislation and politically motivated prison sentences targeting opposition politicians, civil society organisations, human rights defenders and independent media; recalls that the unlawful ‘Foreign Agents Law’, enacted in 2012, has imposed severe constraints on Russian civil society;
amendments.proposedText: 8.	Decries the continued suppression by the Russian authorities of any form of dissent, including through repressive legislation and politically motivated prison sentences targeting opposition politicians, civil society organisations, human rights defenders and independent media; recalls that the unlawful ‘Foreign Agents Law’, enacted in 2012, has imposed severe constraints on Russian civil society; condemns the legislation introduced in Russia in 2022 criminalising the dissemination of information deemed ‘false’ concerning the Russian armed forces and public statements deemed to ‘discredit’ them, which is incompatible with Article 19 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights; deplores the use of these provisions to prosecute and silence elected representatives, activists, including trade unionists and left-wing anti-war activists, journalists and citizens for opposing or publicly criticising Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine; stresses that these laws have contributed to the systematic suppression of anti-war political dissent and pluralism in Russia;

amendments.onBehalfOf: on behalf of The Left Group
amendments.proposedText: 19a.	Calls on the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, the Commission and the Member States to apply the same standards on electoral integrity consistently to all third countries, including EU partners;
